Politics · World

Multiple people killed in shooting at US restaurant

A shooting occurred at an In-N-Out Burger restaurant in Twin Falls, Idaho, on Saturday afternoon, resulting in the deaths of three people and injuries to two others. The shooter was among those killed. Authorities are investigating the motive behind the attack.
